note: Beginner canal town. glTF axes (+y up, x east, +z south = toward the game camera). Load every `landscape` GLB at the origin, then one instance per placement: position pos, rotation rot_y_deg about +y (x' = x cos + z sin, z' = -x sin + z cos, as world3d layout.ts anchorToWorld), uniform scale (default 1). Generated by tools/blender/town_layout.py; edit the script, not this file.

sun.note: compass bearing of the sun from north (-z) toward east (+x); elevation above the horizon

walkable.note: grid classes 1-5 walkable; subtract blockers (oriented rects: centre [x, z], half_size along the rotated local x / z, aabb [xmin, zmin, xmax, zmax]); bridge-slot cells (5) take their height from bridges[].walk_path; the pier deck is walkable along piers[].walk_path.

camera_path.note: Cubic Hermite per segment [k_i, k_i+1], s = (t - t_i) / dt, dt = t_i+1 - t_i: p = h00 p_i + h10 dt m_i + h01 p_i+1 + h11 dt m_i+1 (h00 = 2s^3-3s^2+1, h10 = s^3-2s^2+s, h01 = -2s^3+3s^2, h11 = s^3-s^2). Tangents m (units / s) are Catmull-Rom (p_i+1 - p_i-1) / (t_i+1 - t_i-1), zero at both ends (ease in / out). Same for look_at; fov_deg (vertical) is linear. Last key = game camera at spawn.
